name: NocRoom Miami IT Services

profile.reading: NocRoom is a Miami, Florida based provider describing colocation, IP transit, network based services, and local IT services (fiber and copper network installation, PBX VOIP, email, IP routing, servers, virtualization) across Los Angeles, Dallas, and Miami on its own site. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This operators own homepage, refetched this session, describes only city level service areas and gives no facility specific street address, and a contact page and an about page both failed to fetch this session due to the sites own robots file returning a server error. Reverse geocoding this rows own independently stored coordinates through a third party geocoding service returned 14201 129th Place Southwest, in a residential feeling southwest Miami-Dade subdivision, as the nearest addressable building to this exact point, which reads as an unlikely data center or colocation location and is not confirmed by this operators own site. Separately, a facility specific aggregator listing named a distinct NocRoom facility in downtown Miami at 36 Northeast 2nd Street, roughly 20 kilometers from this rows own coordinates, describing it as an all fiber network serving downtown Miami colocation, dedicated servers, and hosted PBX. Given these two candidate addresses conflict, the reverse geocoded candidate reads as implausible for this type of facility, and neither is confirmed by this operators own site as tied specifically to this row, this session declines to apply either as this rows confirmed address.
